versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the print-quote-calc skill as a professional printing quotation calculator.
- Supports automatic calculation of total printing price, process costs, and suggested profit based on user inputs (paper type/size/quantity/printing method).
- Covers a wide range of print products including business cards, flyers, brochures, packaging boxes, stickers, and paper bags.
- Provides reference tables for paper prices, sizes, printing and finishing process costs.
- Includes a detailed step-by-step calculation guide and standardized quotation output template.
- Offers practical tips for handling common pricing and customer negotiation scenarios.
